description: This Java class defines a size validator for policy commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract validator, manages a singleton instance, and creates exceptions when policy command sizes exceed specified limits.

classes.name: PolicyCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates the size of policy commands, extends AbstractCommandSizeValidator, and implements singleton pattern.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PolicyCommandSizeValidator, initializing it on first call based on the system property for maximum size.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Constructs and returns a PolicyTooLargeException when the actual size exceeds the maximum allowed size.
